title: How Far Can Lightweight LLMs Go in Intent-to-SLO Translation?
abstract: arXiv:2611.07982v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intent-based networking (IBN) promises QoS provisioning in which the network derives the configuration from operator-stated goals. Its first step, translating a natural-language intent into enforceable service-level objectives (SLOs) grounded in a live snapshot of the network state, increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs). These large models add cost and energy to the management loop and typically require multi-GPU, cloud-hosted infrastructure. Can lightweight open LLMs take over this step dependably? We answer this question with a five-dimensional evaluation of ten LLMs with <10B parameters from five families, under four prompting setups, on 716 placement intents. We evaluate translation performance, intent validation, hallucination, energy impact, and robustness to diverse phrasing. translated_title: 轻量级大语言模型在意图到SLO转换中能走多远？
translated_abstract: 意图驱动网络（IBN）承诺实现服务质量（QoS）供给，即网络根据运营商声明的目标自动推导网络配置。其第一步是将自然语言意图转换为可执行的服务级别目标（SLO），并基于网络状态的实时快照，这一步越来越依赖于大语言模型（LLM）。然而这些大型模型给管理环路带来了成本和能耗负担，且通常需要多GPU的云端托管基础设施。那么轻量级开源大语言模型能否可靠地接管这一步骤？我们通过一项五维度的评估来回答这个问题：对来自五个家族的十个参数量小于10B的大语言模型，在四种提示设置下，针对716个放置意图进行测试。我们评估了翻译性能、意图验证、幻觉、能耗影响以及对多样化表述的鲁棒性。最佳配置以0.943的严格F1分数翻译意图，并在195个无效意图中成功拒绝多达191个。通过少样本推理，……
tldr: 该论文通过五个维度的系统评估证明，参数量小于10B的轻量级开源大语言模型能够可靠地将网络自然语言意图转换为SLO，最佳配置达到0.943的严格F1分数并能识别绝大多数无效意图，且能耗成本远低于大型模型。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates through a five-dimensional evaluation that lightweight open-source LLMs (<10B parameters) can reliably translate natural-language network intents into SLOs, with the best configuration achieving a strict F1 of 0.943 and rejecting up to 191 of 195 invalid intents at far lower cost and energy than large models.
